units.source_text: 夕雾闻知老夫人请僧众举行祈祷，便备办种种布施物品及祈祷时所用净衣，遣人殷勤致送。

en.t: When Yugiri learned that the elderly lady had invited monks to hold prayers, he prepared various offerings and the pure robes to be used during the rites, and sent someone to deliver them with great courtesy.

units.source_text: 老夫人患病，不能亲自作书答谢。

en.t: The elderly lady was ill and could not personally write a letter to express her thanks.

units.source_text: 众侍女说：“对这身份高贵的人，叫寻常人代笔答谢，似乎大不礼貌了。”

en.t: The waiting women said, "For someone of such high rank, it would seem terribly discourteous to have an ordinary person write the reply of thanks on her behalf."
They therefore urged the princess to write the reply.

units.source_text: 公主的手笔非常优美，寥寥数语，着墨不多，然而语甚亲切。

en.t: The princess's handwriting was extremely beautiful; though she wrote only a few brief words and used little ink, her tone was very warm.

units.source_text: 夕雾看了越发恋恋不舍，为欲多看公主手笔，此后频频和她通信。

en.t: After reading it, Yugiri became even more reluctant to let go, and because he wanted to see more of the princess's handwriting, he corresponded with her frequently from then on.

units.source_text: 夫人云居雁看见他们如此亲热，逆料将来定会生事，脸上时见不快之色。

en.t: His wife, Kumoi no Kari, seeing how close they had become, foresaw that trouble would surely arise in the future, and from time to time displeasure showed on her face.

units.source_text: 夕雾心有顾忌，虽欲亲赴小野访问，一时未便即刻实行。

en.t: Yugiri had reservations in his heart, and although he wished to go personally to Ono to visit her, for the moment it was not convenient to put this into action at once.
